instruction.name: vilvl.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, interleave the 8-bit elements in the lower half of that lane from `a` and `b`: the element from `b` is placed at the even output position and the element from `a` at the following odd position.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
